decision.reason: [ev-371cba9ffb93] is a single line saying SourceNamespaces now filters destinations (envoy clusters) for unreachable routes. It does not say what SourceNamespaces is, such as which resource or field it belongs to, so the subject cannot be typed. It also does not say who is exposed: whether this applies by default, needs configuration or depends on a flag. The PR or a fuller release note (51936) describing the field and when the filtering applies is needed.
